scientific_intent.scientific_task: Score SNP-pair combinations from packed genotype data
scientific_intent.mathematical_method: Bitwise contingency aggregation and log-gamma-style score approximation
scientific_intent.accuracy_requirements: Exact genotype packing/counts and mask semantics, approximate score accuracy; association score is not biological causality
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Genomics combinatorial scoring operator with integer counting and floating-point score stages
scientific_intent.confidence: Source-grounded scientific intent and operator review only; full model-specific numerical fidelity remains separately audited.
